text.p: Brokerage house Cheuvreux de Virieux lowered its recommendation on Danone stock to sell from buy following the food group's nine-month sales report, portfolio managers said on Friday.
Brokerage Exane held its recommendation to 'lighten' on the stock, while Societe Generale still expects it to outperform, they said.
They said Cheuvreux was disappointed with the five percent sales rise.
On a comparable basis, Danone's nine month sales were up two percent, the company reported on Thursday afternoon.

The stock, which opened down and was 15 francs lower at 736 at 1045 GMT, was hit by slow growth in international sales and weakness in the group's beer and mineral water activities in Europe, brokers said.
